audience.detail: Operators who need a repeatable way to turn a project idea into evidence-backed next work.
audience.label: Project operators

goal.detail: Establish the first evidence-backed recommendation for a synthetic project without pretending that it is a live-market result.
goal.title: Validate a project research loop

non_goals: Publish or change a public account.
Treat synthetic fixtures as real customer research.
research_question: What must be known before a project can receive its first bounded recommendation?

success_signal.detail: All four readiness steps are explicit, evidence-bound where needed, and the recommendation is only ready to queue.
success_signal.label: A verified first recommendation
